text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow's going to be my last race with
Orfe-san…? 
Whatever do ya mean?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't figured anything out… 
…Ya don't mean… ya want me to give up,
do ya?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
! 
Wait, so…

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ……Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Trainer——
choice_data_list: And finally… JUST KINDA DO NOTHING!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ……Now what d——

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(…What the heck are ya thinking? 
You're tellin' me to go run!?
How am I supposed to do that…)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(——When you're actin' like a weirdo!?
That was gonna be our big moment!
…SO WHY'D YA START ACTIN' LIKE WE'RE
GOIN' CLUBBIN'?
AND THEN YA KILLED THE DANG VIBE ANYWAY!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(IT DON'T MAKE NO SENSE!
PLAIN AND SIMPLE!! 
Urgh, seriously, seriously, seriously,
SERIOUSLY!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (WHAT'S YA FRIGGIN PROBLEEEEEEEEEEEEEM!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…Trainer…! 
Did I——
choice_data_list: Yeah, you just ran your absolute best!
Yeah, you just ran your absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I did, didn't I!?
But how did I manage to do that…? 
…What on earth did ya figure out? 
Something to do with what ya did before I
ran…?
choice_data_list: It's simple—— You blew up at me!
It's simple—— You blew up at me!

text_block_list.text:
A foil blowing up on their fool reveals all
their feelings in a big explosive release.
In an effort to be a prim and proper star,
she'd held all her emotions back.
But because of that——

As a racer,
there were going to be times where she'd
need to let her instincts loose.
So if we found a way to set off an
explosive emotional reaction,
we could use that to boost her racing.
choice_data_list: So I'm going to act like a dummy f...
So I'm going to act like a dummy f...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What kinda stupid logic is dat?!! 
…Oh.
choice_data_list: You've figured it out too, haven't...
You've figured it out too, haven't...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: W-Well, maybe I have… Though I have to say it's a bit of an odd idea… No, it's an incredibly odd idea.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That ain't a good thing! 
……Guh. H-Heehee. Hee.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Er… That is to say, Trainer… 
Could we possibly discuss this in more
detail——

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Can ya slow down!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' ya,
dat's da part I don't get! 
Though……………… 
I guess that's all right.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ya seem to be serious about this… Well, as serious as you can be. If we've come this far, we don't have a choice but to give this a shot.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
All right,
tomorrow… We're gonna put an end to this long,
long fight!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer… 
If ya please.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ……Right.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ………And?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Orfe-san's majesty… This pressure… No matter
how many times we race,
she always sends a shiver down my spine. 
But this time… There's something else on my
mind——)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ("You're lilacly to win this!"!?!!!??)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(…Da flower puns sucked,
sure… But puttin' that aside. 
What da heck was with da last one? 
I mean, really, that just ain't right——)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (ARE YA TOO CHICKEN TO TELL ME I CAN WIIIIIIIIIN!!??)

At that moment,
Lucky Lilac's legs unleashed an explosive
power. 
——Her biggest burst of speed yet.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ——Satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh…?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
'Tis thy loss.
However… We perceived a supreme light
within 
thee. That light is the flame of kings,
passed down 
through the ages. ——Let it wane at thy peril,
Lala.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…It's really over… 
I… I finally got Orfe-san's approval…!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I learn to harness that explosivity,
and combine 
it with my controlled racing… Then I can
aim even higher. 
…I think that's what she wanted to tell
me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, someone's confident! …Ahem. Well,
either way, I got 
her approval because ya helped me.
I really can't thank ya 
enough.

She persevered in controlling herself every
day… Through her 
hard work pursuing her ideal beauty,
she created a gap. 
A gap that gave her the potential to unleash
that explosive speed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wh——

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …Of course.
choice_data_list: So please, be my comedy partner!
So please, be my comedy partner!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The word you're lookin' for is TRAINEE!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Haha… Ahahaha! …Well… I accept.
Now then… 
I still have a lot to learn… But I'm honored
to work with ya, 
if you'll have me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Of course… But don't forget,
a team of trainer and trainee, all right?
…Though I wouldn't mind doin' a bit of comedy
every 
now and then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
After all——
I don't think there's anyone else 
I could have such a fun back-and-forth
with.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…And so ends the story of how we first
met. 
What do ya think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
TOO MANY LAS! Okay,
that does sound like it'd be fun to say, 
but still! If you're gonna say my name,
say it properly!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I know ya know how to say it! Sure,
it's a bit of a tongue 
twister, but still! Besides,
we agreed ya'd call me something 
else, remember?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Everybody's happy☆ NO! …We agreed on "Luck",
remember!? 
"Lala" is just too cute of a nickname for
a foil.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: NOW? The show's basically already over! …So, anyway, that should give ya all a good idea of how this trainer-trainee comedy duo's takin' on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Don't just decide that for 'em! 
——Yeah, I'm done! That's all, folks!
——Lala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello,
Ai-san. …Finished with training? 
Good work.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Mmhm. I saw your race back there.
It was amazing. 
…No wonder everybody's got their eyes on
you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
With your skills,
you can rack up wins like it's nothing. 
I'm sure I'm going to see you standing
against me some time 
soon… BUT!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to lose! 
Not to you,
or any other Umamusume that'll cross my
path!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…
…Hehe. Hungry for victory as always,
aren't ya. 
We'll continue this—— On the turf.
